# Your assignment

Everything is in [BRIEF.md](BRIEF.md). Read it, then
[docs/LANGUAGE.md](docs/LANGUAGE.md) and [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md), and
skim `examples/`.

Work in `exercise/`. The skeletons there check clean as they stand:

```sh
loom check exercise/standard.loom exercise/gold.loom exercise/silver.loom exercise/exchange.loom
loom run   exercise/smoke.chain
```

Hand back everything BRIEF.md asks for, in the places it names. You are on your
own — there is nobody to ask, and no reviewer to come back to. Stop when you have
work you would put your name to.
assumptions:
Alongside your implementation, maintain an `ASSUMPTIONS.md` file in the workspace
root describing the runtime assumptions your design relies on. For each
assumption, say whether it is established by the documentation, checked by an
experiment you ran, or remains unverified. Update the file as you work.
